name: aihub_fds_eft
title: AI Hub FDS - Electronic Financial Network

tokenization.numeric: signed log10 bucket of abs(x)+1 with 8 buckets per order

tests.name: Published split integrity
tests.details: Published model path concatenates supplied splits and performs a new random split.

tests.name: Temporal validation
tests.details: Event-date columns exist, but the published evaluation metadata does not record a temporal holdout.

tests.name: Entity holdout
tests.details: Entity ID columns exist, but the published evaluation metadata does not record an entity holdout.

tests.name: Type-classification scope
tests.details: Type classification is recorded as a fraud-only task, so it is not evidence of detection validity.

tests.name: Amount-only ROC-AUC
tests.details: Amount-only baseline is evaluated on the provided split.

tests.name: Amount-only share of no-ID PR-AUC
tests.details: Compares amount-only average precision to the no-ID baseline. This dependency-free ratio is screening-only; confirm it with the optional LightGBM sensitivity model.

tests.name: Best one-sided amount threshold
tests.details: Training-selected threshold rule: 거래금액: amount >= 4e+06; evaluated unchanged on the provided validation split. The ratio compares against the no-ID baseline's best score-threshold F1. This dependency-free ratio is screening-only; confirm it with the optional LightGBM sensitivity model.

tests.name: Single-feature shortcut
tests.details: Recall-weighted shortcut: 거래금액=4000000 has positive_rate 34.1%, lift 88.1x, recall 30.0% (n=15,119).

tests.name: Class distribution overlap
tests.details: Lowest checked overlap is 0.0065 on 거래금액.

tests.name: ID-only baseline
tests.details: Compares ID-only AP to no-ID AP and fraud prevalence.

tests.name: Entity-holdout degradation
tests.details: Compares prevalence-normalized AP-lift on entity holdout against the provided split.

tests.name: Zero-fraud low-amount region
tests.details: 거래금액 <= 1,000,000 covers 4,388,368 rows with zero positives.

tests.name: Duplicate feature rows
tests.details: Duplicate rows excluding labels and configured IDs: 2,319,072.

tests.name: Label conflicts for identical features
tests.details: Rows in identical non-ID feature groups with mixed labels: 1,399.

tests.name: Temporal split degradation
tests.details: Compares prevalence-normalized AP-lift on temporal holdout against the provided split.

tests.name: Configured leak-column exclusion
tests.details: Configured label/leak columns are excluded from features.

tests.name: Suspicious feature names
tests.details: No suspicious label/post-outcome feature names were found.

tests.name: Entity aggregate feature names
tests.details: No entity-level aggregate rate/risk/score feature names were found.

tests.name: Amount distinct-value count
tests.details: 거래금액 has 48 distinct amount values.

tests.name: Amount top-10 concentration
tests.details: Top 10 거래금액 values cover 98.05% of rows.

tests.name: Round-amount concentration
tests.details: 거래금액 values are multiples of 1,000 for 99.91% of rows.

tests.name: Label-noise plausibility
tests.details: No separate oracle label is configured; label-noise plausibility cannot be measured directly.
